mapper.select: SELECT ID, CABINET_NO, TOOL_CODE, POSITION, SNAPSHOT_TYPE, BORROW_RECORD_ID, CREATE_TIME FROM TOOL_CABINET_SNAPSHOT WHERE BORROW_RECORD_ID = #{borrowRecordId} ORDER BY SNAPSHOT_TYPE, POSITION
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TOOL_CABINET_SNAPSHOT (CABINET_NO, TOOL_CODE, POSITION, SNAPSHOT_TYPE, BORROW_RECORD_ID) VALUES (#{cabinetNo}, #{toolCode}, #{position}, #{snapshotType}, #{borrowRecordId})

INSERT ALL
